objects: one object carrying one copied typed Changeling characteristic-definition fragment
state_reads: current copied keyword and typed ability-fragment characteristics
timing: the characteristic-defining effect applies continuously before non-CDA layer-4 type effects
hidden_information: the definition reads no player-private state and projection does not expose typed fragments or physical IDs
layers: add every pinned creature subtype in layer 4
apply the CDA before later non-CDA type setting

control_change: controller identity does not affect the object-local definition
zone_change: the compiled fragment is evaluated in every represented zone
source_leaves: the definition belongs to the current object rather than a separate source
